email_subject: Application - Community & Comms Manager at The Fix
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Community & Comms Manager role at The Fix. Your focus on strategic product communications and engagement for independent newsrooms resonates with my background in digital marketing, content, and web.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and optimize websites, craft SEO content, and manage CMS platforms like WordPress. I've developed a keen eye for messaging that drives engagement, from social media posts to newsletters, and I'm comfortable coordinating with designers and stakeholders to keep a content calendar on track. My technical skills in SEO and AI tools help me create content that not only informs but also attracts and retains users.

I have a genuine interest in MediaTech and the media sector, and I'm eager to bring my experience in onboarding and retention communications to support The Fix's growth. Fluent in English and native in Turkish, I also have familiarity with the CEE region through my work with clients in Turkey.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Community & Comms Manager position at The Fix. As a digital marketer with a technical edge, I have spent the past years building and optimizing websites, crafting content that ranks, and using AI to automate workflows. The opportunity to own strategic product communications for a shared media services platform serving independent newsrooms aligns perfectly with my skills and interests.

In my freelance work and my role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have taken full ownership of communication channels for various clients. I create compelling content, from social media posts to newsletters, and manage CMS platforms like WordPress to ensure consistent, engaging messaging. I have experience running recurring content calendars involving multiple stakeholders, coordinating with designers on creative assets, and using analytics to refine strategies. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and running technical SEO audits that measurably improved search visibility. I also manage content for client sites, ensuring on-page SEO and engaging blog posts that attract and retain audiences.

While my formal experience in customer onboarding and retention is limited, I have a strong foundation in creating user-focused content and optimizing user journeys. I am genuinely interested in MediaTech and the broader technology industry, and I follow developments in the media/journalism sector closely. My native Turkish and familiarity with the CEE region through client work in Turkey give me an additional perspective that could be valuable.

I am fluent in English and comfortable working with cross-functional teams. I am eager to bring my mix of SEO, content, and AI-driven automation to The Fix, helping to attract new media outlets and service providers while keeping existing users engaged.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
